notes: Grown on a placed farm tile; a tile without a farm object is rejected (src/journey.js gardenAction).
The slowest and scarcest sowing: fifty minutes of server time for one unit, gathered one at a time rather than in a bundle.

A single tend shortens growth by five minutes, capped by the growth still ahead of the crop. The care bands divide the crop's own fifty minutes, so a bountiful resin may be tended inside its first sixteen.
The garden cap counts every growing crop the same way, so a bed of resin costs as much room as a bed of blossom and gathers far less. That is the trade the slow kind makes.
Seeds themselves are free and unlimited; the twenty-crop garden cap is unchanged.
